ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 60:40 ratio of high-intensity white to low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central high-intensity white zones are bordered by low-intensity black margins on the leading and trailing edges. Dense black mottling and speckling are present within the white regions, particularly concentrated along the medial borders of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serrated boundary with frequent peaks and valleys along the entire trailing edge; serrations are more pronounced and closely spaced on the distal halves of each lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex sweep trajectory along the trailing edge of both lobes, terminating in sharp lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct clusters of high-contrast white circular pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized on the extreme lateral tips of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several dark linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible, including two parallel diagonal lines on the right lobe and multiple vertical streaks on the inner portion of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization on the distal tips of both lobes and complex pigmentation-based mottling across the ventral surface.
